snippet.title: Purgatory -NARAKU- / 奈落 【PV】
snippet.description:
"Purgatory -NARAKU-" is currently available on Steam!
『奈落』はSteamで好評発売中！

・Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2851770/_/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=pv

This is a survival horror action game in which a young girl "Enri" tries to escape from a mysterious facility filled with blood and madness.
少女「エンリ」が血と狂気に満ちた謎の施設からの脱出を目指す、サバイバルホラーアクションゲームです。

The story begins with many mysteries, and the mysteries are revealed little by little as the game progresses. The game includes elements such as escaping from monsters, searching for items, and solving puzzles.
物語は、多くの謎を抱えた状態から始まり、先に進むにつれて謎が少しずつ明らかになっていきます。怪物からの逃走、アイテム探し、謎解きなどの要素が含まれています。

(C)Gotcha Gotcha Games/Nama

#ゲーム #rpgmaker #Purgatory
